encoding: AEGLND02; root width,height,node count,edge count,edge cap,depth cap; nodes=(children,start,count,winding,hole winding,seed x,y); edges=(ax,ay,bx,by,hole flag), all coordinates float64 normalized in the leaf
modification: Original directed longitude/latitude polygon segments are clipped only for adaptive indexing. Signed winding from an interior source-classified seed evaluates the original vector boundary. No raster coastline, invented smoothing, height, geoid or photographic input.
scope: Source-scale cartographic context, not surveyed shoreline or water height. Original regional reconstructed boundaries and native WBM retain priority. The land product is not a complete inland-water inventory; finite arithmetic can choose either adjacent category on an exact source boundary.
